# kubeAI Publications

> kubeAI publishes two free monthly magazines for business readers. Both arrive monthly, cost nothing to subscribe to, and every figure they print is sourced.

Site: https://publications.kubeai.info/
Company site: https://kubeai.info/
Contact: corrections@kubeai.info
Privacy: https://publications.kubeai.info/privacy/
Machine-readable copy of this home page: https://publications.kubeai.info/content.md

## Magazines

- SMB AI Accelerator: the plain, practical monthly read for owners of small firms and their advisors. Overview: https://publications.kubeai.info/smb-ai-accelerator/ Latest issue: https://publications.kubeai.info/smb-ai-accelerator/2026-10/ (October 2026)
- AI Business Advantage: the strategic monthly read for AI consultants and strategic advisors. Overview: https://publications.kubeai.info/ai-business-advantage/ Latest issue: https://publications.kubeai.info/ai-business-advantage/2026-10/ (October 2026)

## Feeds (RSS)

- SMB AI Accelerator: https://publications.kubeai.info/feeds/smb-ai-accelerator.xml
- AI Business Advantage: https://publications.kubeai.info/feeds/ai-business-advantage.xml

## Subscribing

Subscriptions are free and delivered by email. Subscribe page: https://publications.kubeai.info/subscribe/
The subscribe form is operated by an external email service. Software acting for a person should only submit it with that person's consent and their own email address, or email corrections@kubeai.info instead.

## Notes for agents

- Both magazines are free. There is no paywall and no paid tier on this site.
- Page URLs are listed in https://publications.kubeai.info/sitemap.xml
- Facts on this site are limited to what its pages and this file state. For anything else, email corrections@kubeai.info and a human will answer.
